title: tc-terminal
description: A command line for a panel: output in colour above a prompt with history; the page runs the commands.

heading.description: The heading; empty leaves the header out

description.description: Small text under the heading – the machine or working directory

output.description: Everything printed so far, with ANSI escape codes; pass a longer string as it streams

value.description: The text in the prompt. Changed by typing unless a tc-value-change listener calls preventDefault()

history.description: Earlier commands, oldest first, for ↑ and ↓; commands entered here are added to it

running.description: A command is running: Enter waits, and Stop and Ctrl+C fire tc-interrupt

disabled.description: The prompt can't be used: for a closed session, or output to read only

masked.description: Hides what's typed, for a password prompt, and keeps it out of the history

height.description: Height of the output in px

inputLabel.description: Names the prompt for screen readers
